raw: WhatsApp · 3–4 September 3 Sept, 7:14pm — Kiran Mazumdar: Hi, I got your number from Sonali Patel — you did her flat last year in Viman Nagar. We have a 4BHK in Viman Nagar and want to do the full interiors. Who should I speak to? [No reply — message received after hours] 4 Sept, 9:32am — Kiran Mazumdar: Hi — following up on my message from yesterday? [No reply — front desk not yet in] 4 Sept, 11:47am — Front Desk: Hi Kiran, sorry for the delay — our WhatsApp is monitored from 10am. Thanks for reaching out, and for the referral from Sonali. What size is the flat, and when are you looking to start? 4 Sept, 12:03pm — Kiran Mazumdar: About 1,800 sq ft carpet. We have possession already — flat is empty. Want to start as soon as possible. Design in October, execution starting November? 4 Sept, 12:08pm — Front Desk: That timeline works. Should I book a consultation — we can do a site visit to your flat. 4 Sept, 12:15pm — Kiran Mazumdar: Yes please. Weekdays after 6pm or weekends only for us.

Our pricing depends on materials and scope — our designers go through all of this at a free consultation. Can you tell us about your project? [No reply received] Status: Lead unresponsive after follow-up.

What's the current state of the space? 15 Sept, 3:58pm — Chinmay Kulkarni: Bare shell. Just moved in. Need workstations for 30 people, two cabins, one meeting room. 15 Sept, 4:03pm — Front Desk: Good scope for us. When are you targeting to be operational? 15 Sept, 4:12pm — Chinmay Kulkarni: January if possible. Is that doable? 15 Sept, 4:15pm — Front Desk: Yes — if we start the design process in October, January is achievable. Want to book a site visit? 15 Sept, 4:22pm — Chinmay Kulkarni: Yes. Can you send me a calendar link?

WhatsApp · 20–22 September 20 Sept, 6:44pm (Saturday) — Meena Joshi: Hello — I wanted to inquire about getting my home designed. 2BHK in Baner. We want end-to-end design. Ashok said you're the best, so no need to look further. 17 Sept, 11:41am — Front Desk: Hi Tanvi — Ashok's trust means a lot to us. Congratulations on the new flat! When's possession? 17 Sept, 11:55am — Tanvi Kulkarni: October 15th. 17 Sept, 12:01pm — Front Desk: Perfect. Can we schedule a site visit for the week of October 20? 17 Sept, 12:09pm — Tanvi Kulkarni: Yes — 21st or 22nd works.

WhatsApp · 5–6 September 5 Sept, 4:52pm — Rohit Singh: Hi — I'm opening a gym in Kothrud. About 2,500 sq ft. Would you design the interiors? Looking for something modern and high-energy. 6 Sept, 10:30am — Front Desk: Hi Rohit — we focus on residential and office interiors. Gym and fitness spaces have specific requirements — equipment anchoring, rubber flooring, safety specs — that we're not set up for. You'd need a specialist for this one. Sorry we can't help. 6 Sept, 10:44am — Rohit Singh: Ok thanks.

WhatsApp · 10 September 10 Sept, 8:44am — Pradeep Garg: Hello — I messaged 4 days ago about my flat in Aundh. No one replied. Is anyone monitoring this number? 10 Sept, 10:02am — Front Desk: Hi Pradeep — I sincerely apologise. Your earlier message doesn't appear in this thread — it may have gone to a different number. Please tell me about your project and I'll make sure we respond promptly. 10 Sept, 10:17am — Pradeep Garg: It was this number. 2BHK in Aundh. 850 sq ft. Full interiors. But now I'm not sure I want to work with a studio that doesn't reply for 4 days. 10 Sept, 10:21am — Front Desk: I completely understand. This isn't the experience we want anyone to have. If you're open to it, I'd like to connect you directly with our designer today — not in a few days. Would that work? 10 Sept, 10:35am — Pradeep Garg: Fine. Yes. Note: Lead highly frustrated. Response-time failure. Escalate to senior designer for same-day outreach.

WhatsApp · 25–26 September 25 Sept, 3:18pm — Neha Deshpande: Hi! I want to redo my living room in Aundh. Here's what it looks like. [3 photos attached — living room, open dining area, partial kitchen view] 25 Sept, 3:19pm — Neha Deshpande: It's a 3BHK apartment. We want to start with the living room and dining area. Maybe the kitchen too. [No reply — message received late afternoon, missed] 26 Sept, 11:08am — Front Desk: Hi Neha, sorry for the delay — the photos are great reference, lovely natural light. We'd love to redesign the space. Is this a full execution project, or just design advice? 26 Sept, 11:15am — Neha Deshpande: Full execution — design, materials, furniture, all of it. 26 Sept, 11:18am — Front Desk: Perfect, that's our scope. Location is Aundh? 26 Sept, 11:20am — Neha Deshpande: Yes — Sunderban area. 26 Sept, 11:22am — Front Desk: Great — that's in our area. Shall we set up a site visit?
